div.p: This case-sensitive code system https://fhir.health.gov.fj/CodeSystem/fiji-mataqali provides a fragment that includes following codes:

description.value:
A code system representing mataqali recognised in Fiji, for use in healthcare information exchange where identification of a mataqali is required.
Codes and display names must be sourced from an authoritative dataset approved for the intended use. Access, disclosure and use of customary information must respect applicable Fiji laws and governance.
